fact: The National Assembly of Seychelles says a first cohort of Seychelles civil servants, including its own staff, took a two-week NCGG capacity-building programme in India (11-22 May 2026) covering digital public infrastructure and AI, under an MoU to train 250 civil servants, and graduated on 22 May.
system: First Capacity Building Programme for the Civil Servants of Seychelles (NCGG)

fact: India's Press Information Bureau says NCGG began the first two-week programme for 29 senior Seychelles civil servants on 11 May 2026, covering digital public infrastructure, AI-enabled governance, e-Courts and digitisation and digital payments, as the first milestone of a three-year NCGG-Public Service Bureau MoU to train 250 civil servants.
